title: Stimulate the Critical Thinking of LLMs via Debiasing Discussion

live_model.evidence: Sec 1 footnote 1: "The examples and results are from testing GPT-4 Turbo, which is one of the best LLMs in the world." (Figure 1 motivating example); Sec 3: "Utilizing GPT-4 turbo as the base model, we constructed Eq-Discussion" (200K-dialogue synthetic dataset generator).

prompt.location: Appendix A/B are cited for "agent prompts" used to build Eq-Discussion, but no prompt text appears in the extracted text; Figure 1's motivating accuracy histogram is not reproduced as text either

claim.metric: none quotable (Figure 1's motivating accuracy histogram is described only qualitatively, "less than half of the ideal situation"; the main Tables 1/2/3/4 report only open-source models - LLaMA3, ChatGLM3, Vicuna, Mistral - with and without the authors' MDTA fine-tuning method)
claim.location: Figure 1(c)-(d) (figure only); Tables 1-4 do not include a GPT-4 Turbo row

data.source: Eq-Discussion (200,000 dialogues, 100M tokens), authors' own synthetic dataset generated with GPT-4 Turbo; no release link found in the text

notes: GPT-4 Turbo's two uses are (1) a qualitative, figure-only motivating example, and (2) the generator model for a training dataset (role A); the paper's actual accuracy tables (Tables 1-4) fine-tune and evaluate only open-source 7-8B models, never GPT-4 Turbo itself.
